about_the_game:
The Bonus Mission Pack includes the following content:
- 15 side missions that take place throughout the main story. Completing these missions will reward you with Power Parts.
- 1 Bonus mission

*Bundles that include the above content are also available. Please be careful to avoid duplicate purchases.

content_descriptors.notes: Game contains language not appropriate for all ages, revealing outfits, animated violence, mild alcohol references, and mild suggestive themes.
